# offramp.yml: Offramp configuration.
# Reference: https://github.com/Andorbal/offramp/blob/main/docs/spec/03-configuration.md
# Precedence: built-in defaults < this file < OFFRAMP_* environment variables < command-line flags.
version: 1

# Integer major version of the modern target (10 = net10.0). --target overrides.
target: 10

# The solution (.sln, .slnx, or .slnf) Offramp works on.
solution: src/Monolith.sln

paths:
  # Repository-relative globs. Excluded projects stay in the model but are never modified.
  exclude: []
  state: .offramp

verify:
  # build: dotnet build the affected projects | command: run verify.command | none
  mode: build
  timeoutSeconds: 1800
  configuration: Debug
  # Extra -p: values for every verification build and for scan, for example:
  #   GenerateSerializationAssemblies: "Off"
  properties: {}
  noWarn: []
  restore: true
  # For movers: rollback | keep
  onFailure: rollback

deps:
  # Packages that must share one version, for example:
  #   - prefix: "Microsoft.Extensions."
  families: []
  # Hard version pins. Always give a reason.
  #   - package: Newtonsoft.Json
  #     project: src/Customer.Api/Customer.Api.csproj
  #     version: "9.0.1"
  #     reason: "Customer integrations depend on 9.x serialization behavior"
  pins: []
  cpm:
    # Where `deps consolidate` writes PackageVersion items.
    file: Directory.Packages.props
    scope: solution

move:
  # none | per-project | batch:N | end
  verify: end
  namespaceMismatch: allow

# Per-rule severity overrides. Always give a reason, for example:
#   OFR3105: { severity: none, reason: "We never run on Linux" }
rules: {}

llm:
  # LLM garnish (naming, ranking) stays off unless enabled here or with --llm.
  enabled: false
